name: Runge–Kutta Time Integration
summary: Propagate ODE and method-of-lines semidiscrete PDE states using staged derivative evaluations.
summary_zh: 通过多个内部阶段计算导数，再组合更新下一时间步的状态。
core_idea: Compute one time step from a weighted collection of intermediate vector-field evaluations.
innovation: Provides an explicit/implicit high-order time discretization family for dynamical state prediction.
limitations: Explicit methods can be unstable for stiff dynamics.
Tolerance and step size matter for differentiated trajectories.

start_here.why: Comprehensive derivation of RK families and step-size/stability principles.
